text:
Life that murmurs. Life wide open.
Life smiling, always restless.
Life that flees, turning its head,
temptress, or perhaps just a mischievous child.
Life, nothing more. Blind life
that wants to be lived without great consequences,
without gestures, without historic hysterias,
without transcendent pain or triumphant joy,
light, only light, simply beautiful,
or what on earth we usually call so.

translation.title: Life, Nothing More
